title: HiTOP Factorization Hierarchy
description: Declares one versioned HiTOP factorization as a recursive tree of stable HiTOP base concepts. Every node names the hitop_base_code it plays and the Level (Factor, Superspectrum, Spectrum, Subfactor, Component, Trait) it occupies in this factorization; nesting under `children` is the factorization's concrete parent-child structure. A factorization file never redefines, copies, or duplicates class content; `code` values must already exist in ontology/hitop.ttl. See docs/factorizations.md for the governance model and for how `level` maps onto the core ontology's hitop:hasLevelType/hitop:hasTier vocabulary.

hierarchy.description: Root node of the factorization tree. May be null only while meta.status is "draft" and the tree has not been populated yet.

factorization_id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier matching the factorizations/<factorization_id> directory name.

version.description: Version identifier matching the leading <version>_hierarchy.yaml filename segment and the v<N> directory, for example "V1052k" in v1/V1052k_hierarchy.yaml.

source.description: Origin of the factor structure, for example a source image or dataset path.

paper.description: Citation for the publication this factorization is derived from.

ontology_iri.description: IRI of the core ontology this factorization resolves codes against.

ontology_version.description: owl:versionInfo value of the ontology release the codes were resolved against.

commit.description: Optional git commit hash pinning the exact ontology state the codes were resolved against.

created_by.description: Person or role who curated this factorization.

created_at.description: Date this factorization version was created.

notes.description: Optional free-text provenance notes, for example differences from a previous version.

level.description: Position on the fixed, shared Level ladder (hitop:hasLevel in the core ontology), from broadest to narrowest.

label.description: Human-readable name of the HiTOP concept at this node.

code.description: hitop_base_code from ontology/hitop.ttl that this node names.

bridge.description: Documentation-only cross-loading note: other node labels this concept is also empirically associated with in the source paper. Does not create a second hitop:hasTier edge and is not validated against codes.

provisional.description: Marks this node's placement as tentative, independent of the file-level meta.status.

children.description: Child nodes one Level step below this node, per hitop:hasTier.
